svg.title: Протяжка каната для корпуса — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing cable rope torso rotation, a horizontal chest-height cross-body pull. Full-body oblique front view with one cable tower on the left of each half. One pulley at lower chest height. One continuous cable reaches a short Y-shaped braided rope: exactly two ends, one held in each hand, ends distinct, all connected. Left start: athletic stance feet planted, shoulders turned toward cable tower, both arms held in front of chest with elbows slightly bent and rope close to tower-side chest. Right finish: rotate torso and shoulders away from tower as a unit and guide both hands with rope across body toward opposite side at same chest height, arms still softly bent. Feet stay in same position, one may pivot lightly. Clearly show rotation and cross-body pull while cable line extends out from same side. No crunch, no row facing the machine, no overhead diagonal. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
